description: A large, evergreen tropical tree native to South Asia, widely cultivated for its delicious, sweet, and juicy fruit.
common_diseases:
• Anthracnose
• Powdery mildew
• Bacterial black spot
• Mango hoppers
• Fruit flies
• Scale insects

care_data.water:
• Water deeply and regularly during flowering and fruiting periods.
• Reduce watering during dormancy or cooler months.
• Ensure good drainage to prevent root rot.
care_data.sunlight:
• Requires full sun, at least 6-8 hours of direct sunlight daily.
• Thrives in hot, tropical, and subtropical climates.
care_data.soil:
• Prefers well-draining, loamy soil.
• Tolerates a range of soil types but performs best in slightly acidic to neutral pH (5.5-7.5).
• Amend heavy clay soils with organic matter for improved drainage.
care_data.maintenance:
• Fertilize young trees every 2-3 months, mature trees 2-3 times per year with a balanced fertilizer.
• Prune annually after fruiting to maintain size, shape, and promote air circulation.
• Protect young trees from frost in cooler climates.
• Monitor for pests and diseases and treat promptly.

description: A large perennial herb with a pseudostem formed by leaf sheaths, widely cultivated in tropical landscapes for its broad foliage and edible fruits. It creates a bold architectural accent in gardens and thrives in warm humid climates.
common_diseases: Panama disease, Black Sigatoka, Banana weevil, Aphids

care_data.water: Requires frequent deep watering 2–3 times per week in dry weather to maintain consistently moist soil. Sensitive to drought stress but intolerant of waterlogging.
care_data.sunlight: Prefers full sun exposure for vigorous growth and fruit production, though it tolerates light partial shade in very hot climates.
care_data.soil: Thrives in rich well-drained loamy soil with high organic matter; prefers slightly acidic to neutral pH between 5.5 and 7.0.
care_data.maintenance: Remove spent leaves and harvested pseudostems regularly. Apply nitrogen-rich fertiliser monthly during active growth and mulch heavily to retain moisture.

description: A tall perennial tropical grass cultivated for its high sucrose content, forming thick fibrous stalks up to 6 meters tall. Widely used in agricultural landscapes and as a screening plant in large gardens.
common_diseases: Red rot, smut, leaf scald, sugarcane borers

care_data.water: Requires regular watering especially during active growth; keep soil consistently moist but not waterlogged, with moderate tolerance to short dry periods once established.
care_data.sunlight: Full sun exposure is essential for optimal growth and sugar production.
care_data.soil: Prefers deep, fertile, well-drained loamy soil with high organic matter; optimal pH 6.0–7.5.
care_data.maintenance: Apply nitrogen-rich fertilizer during growing season; remove dry leaves and harvest mature canes annually; monitor for pests and provide good field sanitation.

description: A fast-growing clumping bamboo forming dense thickets with tall woody culms reaching up to 20 meters. Commonly used for screening, erosion control, and ornamental landscaping in tropical and subtropical regions.
common_diseases: Bamboo mites, scale insects, leaf rust, root rot

care_data.water: Water regularly during establishment; prefers consistently moist soil but tolerates brief dry spells once mature.
care_data.sunlight: Thrives in full sun to partial shade; best culm development occurs in full sun.
care_data.soil: Grows best in well-drained loamy soil rich in organic matter; tolerates a range of soils with pH 5.5–7.5.
care_data.maintenance: Prune old or weak culms annually to encourage new growth; apply balanced fertilizer during growing season; contain spread if necessary and monitor for pests.

description: A tropical perennial herb forming a rosette of spiny leaves with a central edible composite fruit. Widely cultivated in tropical landscapes and edible gardens.
common_diseases: Mealybugs; heart rot; root rot; scale insects

care_data.water: Water moderately, allowing soil to dry slightly between watering; drought tolerant once established but sensitive to waterlogging.
care_data.sunlight: Full sun for optimal fruiting; tolerates light shade.
care_data.soil: Well-drained sandy or loamy soil with high organic matter; pH 4.5–6.5.
care_data.maintenance: Remove old leaves and spent fruit stalks; apply balanced fertilizer every 6–8 weeks during growth; ensure good drainage to prevent rot.

description: A fast-growing annual herb producing edible berries commonly used as vegetables. Ideal for kitchen gardens, raised beds, and container cultivation.
common_diseases: Early blight; late blight; powdery mildew; aphids

care_data.water: Water deeply and regularly, keeping soil consistently moist but not waterlogged; avoid overhead watering.
care_data.sunlight: Full sun, at least 6–8 hours daily for best yield.
care_data.soil: Fertile, well-drained loam rich in organic matter; pH 6.0–6.8.
care_data.maintenance: Stake or cage plants; prune suckers for indeterminate types; apply phosphorus-rich fertilizer at planting and balanced feed during fruiting.

description: A succulent perennial with fleshy leaves containing medicinal gel, ideal for xeriscaping and container culture. Adds architectural form to dry gardens.
common_diseases: Root rot; aloe rust; mealybugs; aphids

care_data.water: Water deeply but infrequently; allow soil to dry completely between watering; highly drought tolerant.
care_data.sunlight: Full sun to bright indirect light; protect from intense midday sun in hot climates.
care_data.maintenance: Minimal pruning; remove offsets for propagation; fertilize lightly once or twice during growing season.

description: A fragrant evergreen shrub producing white blossoms used in ornamental gardens and hedges. Popular for its aromatic flowers in tropical landscapes.
common_diseases: Powdery mildew; aphids; whiteflies; root rot

care_data.water: Water regularly, keeping soil evenly moist but not soggy; moderate drought tolerance once established.
care_data.sunlight: Full sun to partial shade; flowers best in bright light.
care_data.maintenance: Prune after flowering to maintain shape; apply balanced fertilizer every 4–6 weeks during blooming season.
